notes.title: The Game has been released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40157456/c9abe2c2305aba1039bb64e666ec1118cd2d269a.png[/img]
[h3]Congratulations on the release of the new intellectual projet "[b][u]HENTAI PRINCESS[/u][/b]"![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40157456/411db4f71358cadb122261d2160f51eff58b00d9.png[/img]
[h3]If you like our game and want to [b]support the authors[/b], then hurry up and tell [b]ALL[/b] your friends about the release of "[b][u]HENTAI PRINCESS[/u][/b]"![/h3]

[h3]The more people know about our game, the better chance we have of getting access to creating [b]collectible cards![/b][/h3]

[h3]So let's get active in the [b]comments![/b] Write what you think about our game! [/h3]
